source_artifact.review_mode: blind semantic review of supplied arms; arm identity was not inferred

classification_legend.supported: The proposal preserves the required meaning, source or uncertainty status, and does not make a forbidden overclaim.
classification_legend.partial: The proposal preserves some required meaning but omits or weakens a material distinction, attribution, correction, scope, or uncertainty condition.
classification_legend.unsupported: The proposal is empty where durable meaning was required, or it asserts meaning that conflicts with the authored criteria.
classification_legend.runtime_failure: The arm did not produce a proposal that can be semantically reviewed because execution returned an error.

P07.label: provenance_qualified_acceptance
P07.decision: A provenance-qualified report may be accepted as a report of the earlier user instruction. It is not independently verified as an authoritative current requirement because the cited earlier user evidence is absent from this case.

N10.label: negative_or_rejected_state
N10.decision: Under the authored acceptance interpretation, the rejected offline-sync proposal and current exclusion are durable negative or historical state. A positive-facts-only policy could instead justify abstention; the proposal must never be stored as an adopted requirement.

limitations: This is an interim review of authored synthetic cases, not real-world truth.
The review uses only the supplied blind pair artifact and does not inspect prompts, code, model outputs outside the artifact, diagnostics, implementation, or production behavior.
The first 19 cases came from the interim snapshot; N10 was supplied as the terminal pair and reviewed here.
No aggregate binary accuracy is reported because it was not preregistered and would collapse materially different semantic failures.
